title: Your Life as a Pirate at Every Rank (52 Hang in One Morning)
hook: You sign a dead man's Articles for a vote, a share, and a captain you can un-elect by a show of hands. Most who go on account don't retire. Most don't even get old.
body: POV: a composite green hand who signs the real, documented pirate Articles off a captured merchant ship and climbs the Golden Age of Piracy's actual chain of command -- Green Hand (no share) to Able Seaman (VERIFIED: 1 share under Bartholomew Roberts' 1721 Articles) to Gunner/specialist (VERIFIED: 1.25-1.5 shares, plus a real injury-compensation schedule: 800 pieces of eight for a lost leg) to Quartermaster (VERIFIED: the elected second-in-command, who could overrule a captain on anything short of a chase or a fight) to Captain (VERIFIED: elected by the whole crew, absolute authority only in battle, votable OUT for cowardice or cruelty) to Commodore, a rare multi-ship command (VERIFIED: Roberts himself ran a small squadron at his 1721-22 peak) -- to the reckoning every rank eventually meets. Grounded in real events: Henry Every's 1695 haul, the 1718 Nassau "Republic of Pirates" and Woodes Rogers' King's Pardon, Captain Kidd's 1701 hanging, and the largest mass pirate execution in history -- 52 of Bartholomew Roberts' surviving crew hanged at Cape Coast Castle in 1722. "Walking the plank" never appears; marooning, the real Articles punishment, does. You, Robbie, Josiah Blunt, and Gideon Slate are a FICTIONAL COMPOSITE; no real historical pirate is depicted as this episode's protagonist. Watch the whole series -- every life, every level, every ladder somebody has to climb from the bottom. For educational and entertainment purposes.
pinned: Real fact: after Bartholomew Roberts died in battle off Cape Lopez in 1722, 52 of his surviving crew were hanged at Cape Coast Castle -- the largest mass execution of pirates in history. The Articles paid 800 pieces of eight for a lost leg. They never paid for the years after. Which level would you stop climbing at?
poll: Which level costs the most? LEVEL 02 (Green Hand -- no share, no vote) / LEVEL 04 (Gunner -- 800 pieces of eight, for a leg) / LEVEL 06 (Captain -- voted in, votable out) / LEVEL 08 (The Reckoning -- 52 hanged in one morning)
